title: An AI glossary
subtitle: The most common AI terms explained, simply
summary: This glossary provides simplified definitions of over 20 common AI terms, making complex concepts accessible to those unfamiliar with AI jargon. It covers essential topics such as AI models, large language models, training methods, and various learning techniques, alongside practical applications like prompt engineering and retrieval-augmented generation. The definitions aim to equip readers with the knowledge needed to engage in discussions about AI technology confidently.
